# SeatRead

`schemas/api/seat.json`

The one record of GET /v1/seat (docs/design/m0/08 "Supervisor seat", adc seat status): the controller's supervisor seat, its holder, its version (what --expect names; 0 before its first event) and its pending handover request. The seat is the controller's, outside any project: it is read only under an every-project read, like its events.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [SeatID](common-defs.md#seatid) |  |
| `holder` | yes | null or [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) | The supervisor holding the seat; null while it is free. |
| `version` | yes | integer (minimum `0`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |
| `grace_seconds` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | The least time a forced handover leaves the holder, from the request's recorded time (authority.SeatMinGrace). |
| `handover` | yes | null or object ([fields](#fields-of-handover)) | The pending handover request; null when there is none. |

No other fields are allowed.
